reason: Rechecked 2026-11-24: agql-auth 0.27.0 drops its direct rsa edge. JWT 11 RustCrypto, the ORM JWT 10 test dependency, SMB SSPI/picky and lock-only SQLx MySQL 0.8.6 still require ^0.9. The fix is in rsa 0.10.0. The router verifies public-key JWTs including via AccessTokenValidator, and the ORM consumes verified principals; only router tests and the fuzz harness sign with synthetic RSA keys. External agql-auth can issue RS256 tokens and sign RS256/PS256 client assertions, outside these runtime paths. SMB uses username/password NTLM with symmetric crypto. Host private-key decryption, key reuse or new private operations require a fresh review.

Rechecked 2026-11-23: unmaintained notice with no patched release. geo-types 0.7.19 weak serde features retain rstar 0.9/0.10/0.11 and heapless 0.7.17 in the locks; those compatibility paths are unselected. The built geo path uses rstar 0.12 and heapless 0.8, which uses portable-atomic. The archived crate has no drop-in upgrade and current geo-types still declares the older rstar ranges.

Rechecked 2026-11-23: unmaintained notice with no patched release. Router locks select serde_yaml 0.9.34 via Datadog/libdd and the VRL build, and serde_yaml_ng 0.10.0 via Hive/VRL. Both retain unsafe-libyaml, including the YAML path of newer VRL, and switching to serde-saphyr requires owner migrations. The typed router supplies no Datadog exporter and loads its own JSON configuration; the notice remains applicable to the resolved parser and does not establish universal unreachability.

Rechecked 2026-11-24: agql-auth 0.27.0 and the router share jsonwebtoken 11.0.0 in the root lock. Their JWT 11 RustCrypto path and the ORM JWT 10 test dependency use p256/p384 0.13 and elliptic-curve 0.13.8, which requires crypto-bigint ^0.5. JWT 12 adopts the newer curves but crosses the current requirements. Router JWT verification uses public keys and workspace signing fixtures use RSA or HS256. SMB also resolves the old curves via SSPI/picky, but the selected username/password NTLM path uses symmetric signing. S3 SigV4a is on 0.7.10. Existing owner acceptance excludes private EC operations.

Rechecked 2026-11-23: this is an unmaintained notice, including 0.1.1. aws-smithy-runtime 1.16.1+ (Rust 1.94.1) and wasmtimer 0.4.4+ migrate off pin-utils, but optional SMB sspi 0.16.1 still needs async-dnssd ^0.5 on macOS/iOS and every 0.5 release retains pin-utils. A complete removal needs a compatible SMB owner migration; no vulnerability is described by this notice.

Rechecked 2026-11-23: sqlx-sqlite 0.8.6 requires libsqlite3-sys ^0.30.1 and cross-crate-relations also pins =0.30.1. SQLx 0.9.1 (Rust 1.94) admits the fixed >=0.39.0 line (Rust 1.88) but changes the public SQLx dependency contract. GraphqlOrmBackupAdapter restores table/change records into a host-selected connection. This exception assumes the host controls writes to both the SQLite database and its sibling WAL; opening a less-trusted pair is outside scope.
